name: Florence
seo_title: Florence OR Christmas Events for Kids 2026
seo_desc: Christmas events for kids in Florence, Oregon for 2026: Old Town tree lighting with Santa, Holly Jolly Follies, a lantern walk and Nativity Festival.
lede: Florence starts its season in Historic Old Town with Santa, a hayride and the city tree lighting, then adds the Holly Jolly Follies, a Nativity Festival, a solstice lantern walk and a Santa visit and craft classes in nearby Mapleton.
celebrates: Florence's season centers on Historic Old Town and the Florence Events Center. The Florence Area Chamber of Commerce holds A Merry Coastal Christmas on December 5, with lighted balloons, Santa and Mrs. Claus at 4 pm and the City Tree Lighting at 5 pm. C.R.O.W. stages the Holly Jolly Follies December 4 to 6 at the Events Center, and the Pacific Coast Wind Ensemble plays a holiday concert there December 13. Mapleton adds a free Santa visit and Saturday craft classes, and Yachats lights its tree on December 5.
lastyear: We did not find a published 2025 recap for Florence, so this page uses the hosts' own 2026 pages. Those pages call several events annual or recurring: the Nativity Festival is the 19th annual, C.R.O.W. says this is its 9th Follies, the chamber calls A Merry Coastal Christmas an annual tradition and Serene Abundance Studio Space calls its Winter Solstice Lantern Walk an annual Florence tradition.
facts: C.R.O.W.'s Holly Jolly Follies has four shows this year, two of them matinees, and ticket prices include all fees. The Nativity Festival says it grew from one day with 119 nativity scenes to three days with 400 creches, tapestries and other art forms. The Florence Events Center sits at 715 Quince St, and the lantern walk crosses the Boardwalk through Old Town Florence at night.
trains: We did not find a Christmas train ride in Florence for 2026. For a train display on the Oregon coast, the Oregon Coast Historic Railway Museum in Coos Bay lights vintage engines and cabooses with 100,000 lights from November 26 through January 1, free to view from the car or sidewalk. It is listed on our Coos Bay page once that page is live.
traditions: The chamber's Bay Street festival on December 5 with Santa at 4 pm and the City Tree Lighting at 5 pm.
C.R.O.W.'s ninth Follies at the Florence Events Center, December 4 to 6, with two matinees.
The 19th annual display of hundreds of nativity scenes, December 4 to 6, free.
Serene Abundance Studio Space's annual walk through Old Town on December 21, with cocoa and cider.
A free drop-in visit with Santa and Mrs. Claus at Blissful Seasons on November 29, plus Saturday craft classes.
kidfact: Florence's Nativity Festival began as a one-day display of 119 nativity scenes and has grown to 400 creches over three days.
faq: The Florence Area Chamber of Commerce holds A Merry Coastal Christmas in Historic Old Town on December 5 with Santa, a hayride and the City Tree Lighting. C.R.O.W. presents the Holly Jolly Follies at the Florence Events Center December 4 to 6.
When is the Florence tree lighting?
The City Tree Lighting Ceremony is at 5 pm on Saturday, December 5, 2026, at Siuslaw River Interpretive Center Park, after the afternoon festival in Old Town.
Where can kids meet Santa near Florence?
Santa and Mrs. Claus arrive in Old Town Florence at 4 pm on December 5. Mapleton hosts a free drop-in visit with Santa and Mrs. Claus on November 29.
Are there free Christmas events in Florence?
Yes. A Merry Coastal Christmas, the Nativity Festival, the Winter Solstice Lantern Walk and the Sleigh Bells and Silver Screens concert are listed as free.
Are Mapleton and Yachats events on this page?
Yes. This page also lists Mapleton's Santa visit and craft classes at Blissful Seasons and the Yachats tree lighting on December 5.
sources: A Merry Coastal Christmas Holiday Festival
C.R.O.W. Center for the Performing Arts
intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Florence for 2026, and here is what he found: 8 family events across Florence and 2 nearby towns, 5 of them free. The magic runs from November 29 (Meet Santa and Mrs. Claus at Blissful Seasons) through December 21, with Holly Jolly Follies: Operation Christmas Magic (December 4 to December 6), Nativity Festival in Florence (December 4 to December 6) and A Merry Coastal Christmas Holiday Festival (December 5) along the way. We check every date on the host’s own website, and each listing links straight there. For the whole area, see Christmas events for kids in Eugene. For the rest of the state, see our Oregon Christmas events for kids guide.
